annotations.title: ISS passes over a Polish city

description: When the International Space Station can be seen with the naked eye over a Polish city in the next 10 days: each pass with its start, highest point and end (time, direction, height above the horizon) and brightness.

lang.description: Language of the answer: pl (default) or en

lat.description: Latitude of another place: the nearest seat is used
